    The Apex Legends Global Series Championship with a total prize pool of USD $1,000,000 will follow the Winter Circuit. Teams will qualify for the Championship through Winter Circuit Playoffs performance, cumulative ALGS Points, and Championship last-chance online tournaments

    Format[edit]

    • Group Stage:
      • Teams are seeded in a Snake Draft method into three different groups by ALGS points
      • There will be 4 group stage days where each group plays every other group in a series of 6 games and then a second time in a series of 2 games
        • Day 1 - BvC
        • Day 2 - AvC
        • Day 3 - AvB
        • Day 4 - BvC, CvA, and AvB
          • After all 4 days of the Group Stage, the top scoring team in each group will advance to the Finals (3 teams). The rest of the spots will go to the top 17 scoring teams through all groups combined.


    Point Distribution

    • At the end of each Match, Teams are awarded points for their placement and the Team’s total number of kills as shown on the in-game end of match summary screen (“Match Score”).
      • To view the points distribution Click here

    Placement Rules

    • There is no match limit in the 2021 APAC-N Championship Finals
      • Once a Team reaches the minimum total points of 50 in the Championship, The next match becomes "Match Point Eligible" for that team.
      • The first team to win a match after they are "Match Point Eligible" is declared the 2021 APAC-N Champion.
        • After the winner is declared, 2nd-20th are ranked by total Finals points.
      • There is no limit to number of teams who can be "Match Point Eligible".

    Seeding

    • The top ten (10) Teams with highest Total Group Stage Match Score will start the Finals with points as follows:
      • To view the awarded points based on seeding Click here
      • 1st seed - 10 points
      • 2nd seed - 9 points
      • 3rd seed - 8 points
      • 4th seed - 7 points
      • 5th seed - 6 points
      • 6th seed - 5 points
      • 7th seed - 4 points
      • 8th seed - 3 points
      • 9th seed - 2 points
      • 10th seed - 1 point

    Prize Pool[edit]

    The initial prize pool of the tournament is $176,400 USD.
    The sales of the five different skin bundles were added to the total prize pool, the crowd funded amount reached $1,580,590 USD as an increase across all regions.[1]
